section_patterns.name: integration_setup
section_patterns.purpose: Prevents failed integration by detailing credentials and steps needed for third-party services.

section_patterns.name: permission_matrix
section_patterns.purpose: Details permission granularity and assignment, preventing unauthorized access and ambiguity in permissions.

section_patterns.name: resource_configuration
section_patterns.purpose: Sets clear bounds on reservation rules per-resource and prevents misuse.

section_patterns.name: role_and_permission_matrix
section_patterns.purpose: Prevents unauthorized access and clarifies which users can perform which actions.

section_patterns.name: troubleshooting
section_patterns.purpose: Guides resolution of common problems and user missteps.

section_patterns.name: accountless_usage
section_patterns.purpose: Clarifies what functionality is available without an account and limitations thereof.

section_patterns.name: announcement_management
section_patterns.purpose: Settles how notifications are shown and targeted to users.

section_patterns.name: availability_window
section_patterns.purpose: Defines when the system must be operational and prevents ambiguity about downtime.

precision_idioms.name: bounded_window
precision_idioms.template: X cannot Y outside of the window from N to M.
precision_idioms.example: No reservations will be allowed outside of the availability date range.

precision_idioms.name: explicit_default
precision_idioms.example: By default only logged in users can view schedules, but this can be changed with some configuration updates.

precision_idioms.name: must_never_invariant
precision_idioms.template: X must never Y; verified by Z.
precision_idioms.example: Resources cannot be double the product.

precision_idioms.name: state_transition_rule
precision_idioms.template: State X transitions to Y only when condition Z.
precision_idioms.example: The reservation becomes active only after an administrator approves it.

precision_idioms.name: permission_matrix
precision_idioms.template: Role W users may perform X on resources Y under conditions Z.
precision_idioms.example: Resource Administrators have the same capabilities as Application Administrators for any resource which the group is assigned to.

precision_idioms.name: error_table
precision_idioms.example: The Unavailable status will show the resource on the schedule but will not allow it to be the product by anyone other than administrators.

precision_idioms.name: exactly_once
precision_idioms.template: Operation X must happen exactly once per Y.
precision_idioms.example: You must have at least one schedule defined and every resource must belong to a schedule.

precision_idioms.name: explicit_relationships
precision_idioms.template: X must have relationships: has many Y, belongs to Z, etc.; verified by ORM/model structure.
precision_idioms.example: Has many Products, Orders, Attendees, Questions

edge_case_patterns.name: timezone_boundary
edge_case_patterns.resolution: Quota limits and scheduling are enforced based on schedule's timezone, not user's.

edge_case_patterns.name: accountless_action
edge_case_patterns.resolution: Users without accounts have restricted access to certain features and alternate identification flows.

edge_case_patterns.name: approval_pending_state
edge_case_patterns.resolution: Reservation is not active until approval is granted, with optional notification and re-pending for updates.

edge_case_patterns.name: auto_expiry
edge_case_patterns.resolution: Resources are automatically deleted after inactivity and no upcoming relevance, with noted exceptions.

edge_case_patterns.name: background_task_temporal_context
edge_case_patterns.resolution: Temporal context must be explicitly passed to background tasks to ensure correct time-dependent behavior.

edge_case_patterns.name: billing_adjustment_window
edge_case_patterns.resolution: Seat/billing changes mid-cycle are prorated or credited appropriately dependent on timing.

edge_case_patterns.name: blackout_conflict
edge_case_patterns.resolution: No reservations allowed during blackout times, overrides all users including administrators.

edge_case_patterns.name: calendar_account_duplicate
edge_case_patterns.resolution: Allow linking of only one external calendar account per provider.
